senses.gloss: f. (צָבַע I) handling; בית הצ׳ that part of a vessel by which it is handled, v. צְבִיטָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:7">Kel. XXV, 7</cite> <he>כל הכלים … ובית הצ׳</he> all vessels have backs, insides and handling places (independent of one another, v. <cite ref="R00041"><he>צְבִיטָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:8">ib. 8</cite> <he>כיצד … אחזו בבית צְבִיעָתוֹ וכ׳</he> how is this? If one’s hands are clean, and the back of a cup is unclean, and he seizes it by its handling place.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:8">Ib.</cite> <he>נטילתו באחת צביעתו באחת</he> that which is taken up with one hand (at one special place) has one handling place (for the purposes of levitical cleanness); <he>מקום אחיזתו שם צביעתו</he> at whatever place a vessel is taken hold of, there is its handle.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:1:2">Y. Ḥag. III, 78ᵈ</cite> bot.; a. fr.
